Clean build with 0 warnings, 0 errors. Here's a summary of what was created:

**UniversityCourseCatalog** — a static SSR Blazor Web App (no interactivity mode needed for an intranet with fast connectivity).

### Structure
| Layer | Files |
|-------|-------|
| **Models** | `Department.cs`, `Course.cs`, `EnrollmentRequest.cs` (with DataAnnotations validation) |
| **Services** | `ICatalogService` / `CatalogService` — in-memory catalog with 6 departments, 15 courses, search & filter |
| **Pages** | `Home.razor` — featured courses + department links |
| | `Courses.razor` — searchable/filterable table (query-string driven) |
| | `CourseDetail.razor` — full details, schedule, credits, instructor bio |
| | `Enroll.razor` — standard HTML form with server-side validation |
| | `EnrollConfirmation.razor` — post-submit confirmation |
| **Layout** | Updated `NavMenu` (Home, Browse Courses, Enroll) |

### Key design decisions
- **Static SSR only** — no WebSocket/SignalR overhead; ideal for intranet
- **Query-string filtering** — bookmarkable, shareable course search URLs
- **`EditForm` + `DataAnnotationsValidator`** — standard server-side form validation on submit (no real-time validation)
- **Singleton `CatalogService`** — swap for EF Core/database later without changing pages
